Heavy bokeh/depth-of-field blur is present. While likely intentional photography style, in AI generation this can sometimes mask structural inconsistencies in the background vegetation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification (Bellis perennis vs other composites) and rule out misclassification as similar flowers like chamomile.
To check for fusion between individual petals and the central disc, ensuring they are distinct topological entities.
To assess overall coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative noise in the blurred regions.
To verify the spatial relationship between the stem, the flower, and the background foliage, ensuring no geometric melting.

focus_areas: Petal-Disc Junction: Check for bleeding or fusion where white petals meet the yellow center.
Petal Individuality: Ensure petals do not merge into each other unnaturally.
Stem Continuity: Verify the stem connects logically to the flower head without disappearing or warping.
Background Coherence: Check if blurred background shapes make sense as foliage.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction between the yellow disc and white petals. AI often blurs this boundary. Also, inspect the 'film strip' borders to determine if they are part of the generation artifact or intentional framing. Verify if the second partial flower at the bottom maintains consistent geometry with the main flower.
